description: Resonant high-pass filter with a choice of two circuits

params.text: Sets the cutoff, five octaves either side of 523.25Hz, so from 16.35Hz at the bottom to 16744Hz at the top
Sets the resonance, 1 to 20 in STANDARD and 0 to 10 in KORG
Chooses the filter: STANDARD is a plain two-pole high pass, KORG models the Sallen-Key high pass of the MS-20

inputs.text: Shifts the cutoff one octave per volt, added to the CUTOFF knob, and the total is held to five octaves either side of 523.25Hz

notes: The CUTOFF knob's tooltip reads 130hz to 2093hz, but the knob actually sweeps 16.35Hz to 16744Hz.
